# Spendy Product Spec (fixture)

## Project Overview
High-level description of the Spendy expense wallet for Egyptian users.

## Functional Requirements Analysis
The product must deliver the following capabilities:

- Add expense with amount, note, and category
- Multi-wallet support with balance per wallet
- Expense categories management
- Monthly budgets with alerts
- Reports and charts for spending trends
- Team members and permissions
- OTP login for phone numbers
- Offline cache for recent expenses
- Voice-to-expense capture via microphone
- OCR receipts via camera APIs
- Currency must be EGP on home and reports

## Implementation Roadmap
Phase 1 MVP then Phase 2 polish. Not a code feature.
